title: Propagate realistic-demo-ids stability rustdoc to chat/tasks/metadata/sharing siblings (calendars + contacts canonical)
description:
Workspace canonical-template propagation follow-up to bd:JMAP-ic0j.63 (calendars-server, closed 2026-05-15) and bd:JMAP-qz9v.31 (contacts-server, closed now).

The stability statement landed in calendars-server (commit e6ede77) was intended to propagate to every sibling that has the realistic-demo-ids feature. Audit at HEAD shows it's still missing from 4 of the 6 siblings:

| Sibling | Has feature | Has stability statement |
|---|---|---|
| jmap-chat-server | yes | NO |
| jmap-calendars-server | yes | yes (canonical) |
| jmap-contacts-server | yes | YES (just landed) |
| jmap-tasks-server | yes | NO |
| jmap-metadata-server | yes | NO |
| jmap-sharing-server | yes | NO |

Mail-server and filenode-server do NOT have the feature; the stability statement is the explicit not-to-be-propagated marker for them and does not apply.

PROPAGATE: port both edits from calendars-server (canonical) verbatim:

1. **Cargo.toml** — the '# Stability (bd:JMAP-ic0j.63):' paragraph and the 'do NOT propagate to extension-server siblings' paragraph in the realistic-demo-ids feature comment. Canonical: crate-jmap-calendars-server/Cargo.toml:29-42.

2. **src/memory.rs demo_next_id rustdoc** — the '# Feature stability (bd:JMAP-ic0j.63)' section. Canonical: crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs:619-646.

Substitute 'calendars-server' / 'CalendarsBackend' for the matching sibling's name in each rustdoc paragraph.

The contacts-server fix that just landed (commit landing alongside this bead) is a workable second template — it changes 'calendars-server' to 'contacts-server' and cites bd:JMAP-qz9v.14 (contacts-specific monotonic-counter bead) for the within-process collision guarantee instead of bd:JMAP-ic0j.2 (calendars-specific). Each sibling should cite its own equivalent bead if one exists, or drop the citation if not.

NO code change — pure rustdoc and Cargo.toml comment. P3 because the failure mode is consumer-relies-on-unstable-format-then-blames-us, not runtime breakage.

The bead's bd:JMAP-qz9v.31 description identified additional concerns the workspace already explicitly accepts as deliberate trade-offs (cargo-feature vs runtime-constructor; no #[doc(cfg)] marker). The stability statement publishes those trade-offs to consumers; this propagation completes the publication.
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (moot, skeptic-confirmed): The realistic-demo-ids feature no longer exists in any Cargo.toml, and there is no demo_next_id in any source file. 2a8bf0aa 'refactor(servers)!: uuid v4 MemoryBackend ids' removed it. The only remaining mention is in CHANGELOG.md:3312. | check: Moot. No realistic-demo-ids or demo_next_id remains in any .rs or .toml file. The only hit is the historical CHANGELOG.md:3312. The feature it asked to document was removed (2a8bf0aa).
